#DE_Macro
## Volcano for DE_Macro
```{r Volcano_DE_Macro}
getwd()
DE_Macro<- read.csv("./DE_Macro/results/2024-06-20/Macrophage-HFSC_vs_Macrophage-Chow/DE_results_Macrophage-HFSC_vs_Macrophage-Chow.csv")
head(DE_Macro) #gene p_val avg_log2FC pct.1 pct.2 p_val_adj
colnames(DE_Macro) <- c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","pct.1","pct.2","adjP.Value")
rownames(DE_Macro) <- DE_Macro$Gene
head(DE_Macro)
x <- DE_Macro

logFCcut <- 1 #log2-foldchange
pvalCut <- 1e-2 #P.value
adjPcut <- 0.01 #adj.P.value

#for advanced mode
logFCcut2 <- 2 
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2 <- 1e-50
pvalCut3 <- 1e-100

#置x，y軸的最大最小位置
xmin <- (range(x$logFC)[1]- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ 10))
xmax <- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ (10-range(x$logFC)[1]))
ymin <- 0
ymax <- 350
# ymax <- -log10(x$P.Value)[3] * 1.1

# 複雜的的setting for color
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
cols <- rep("grey", n1)
names(cols)<- rownames(x)

#不同阈值的点的颜色
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#FB9A99"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- "#ED4F4F"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#B2DF8A"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#329E3F"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#f77e7e"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2]<- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#73b6f5"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#136cbf"
color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)
x$color_transparent <- color_transparent

# 複雜的的setting for size
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
size <- rep(1, n1)

#不同阈值的点的大小
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC > logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC > logFCcut3]<- 6
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3]<- 6

# Construct the plot object
#BiocManager::install('ggthemes')
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)
library(gridExtra)
p1 <- ggplot(data=x, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value), label = Gene, color = pathway)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +

  labs(x=bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"), 
       y=bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")), 
       title="Volcano plot for Macrophages after 12-week HFSC diet") + 
  ylim(c(ymin,ymax)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-10, -5, -2,-logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2, 5, 10), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c(-10, -5, -2, -logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2 , 5, 10),
    limits = c(-11, 12) #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看
  ) +
  #或用下面这行：
  #xlim(c(xmin, xmax)) + 

#画阈值分界线
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) + #虚线的形状和粗细
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  
theme_bw(base_size = 10#, base_family = "Times" #修改字体
         ) +
theme(panel.grid=element_blank())

p1 <- p1 + 
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2), color="grey40", 
             linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1)

# 显示 logFC > n 的基因的基因名
n = 2
p1 + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), 
                      label = ifelse(logFC > n & -log10(P.Value) > 50, rownames(x),"")), 
                  colour="#9c0917", size = 2.5, box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
                  point.padding = unit(0.8, "lines")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), 
                      label = ifelse(logFC < -n & -log10(P.Value) > 50, rownames(x),"")),
                  colour="#0054a3", size = 2.5, box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"), 
                  point.padding = unit(0.8, "lines")) +
  
ggsave("./DE_Macro/DE_Macro_volcano.pdf", width=6,height=6)
ggsave("./DE_Macro/DE_Macro_volcano.png", width=6,height=6)

```

## Bubble for DE_Macro_top
```{r Bubble_Macro_top}
library(ggplot2)
library(readxl)
data <- DE_Macro
data_up <- subset(data,logFC>0)[1:20,1:6]
data_down <- subset(data,logFC<0)[1:20,1:6]
data_top20 <- rbind(data_up,data_down)
data_top20 <- arrange(data_top20,logFC,decrease =T)
data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value == 0] <- min(data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value > 0])/100
# data_top20 <- data_top20[order(data_top20$logFC, decreasing = F),]
# min_nonzero_value <- min(data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value != 0])
# data_top20$P.Value[data_top20$P.Value == 0] <- min_nonzero_value * 1e-2

# Convert Symbol to a factor to control the order of plotting 
data_top20$Gene <- factor(data_top20$Gene, levels = unique(data_top20$Gene))

# Map shapes and colors based on LogFC
data_top20$Shape <- ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, 24, 25) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data_top20$Color <- ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, "#DA7680", "#72A7D9")
data_top20$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data_top20$logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                          levels = c("Up", "Down"))
# Plot
ggplot(data_top20, aes(x=logFC, y=Gene, size=-log10(P.Value), shape=Regulation, color=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#DA7680", "Down" = "#72A7D9")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color="black",face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top20 Up- & Down-regulated Genes",
       size = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P.Value")),
       x="LogFC", 
       y="Gene Symbol",
       color = "Gene Regulation",
       shape = "Gene Regulation")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c(-5, 0, 5), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c(-5, 0, 5),
    limits = c(-7, 7)  #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看 
  ) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17))) 

# Save the plot
ggsave("./DE_Macro/DE_Macro_top20_logFC.pdf", width=5, height=8)
ggsave("./DE_Macro/DE_Macro_top20_logFC.png", width=5, height=8,dpi = 600)
```
## Canonical Pathways 
```{r IPA_cano}
library(readxl)
data <- read_excel("./DE_Macro/results/2024-06-20/IPA/IPA_canonical.xlsx")
colnames(data) <- c("Ingenuity Canonical Pathways","-log(p-value)","zScore","Ratio","Molecules","Counts")
data <- data[order(data$`-log(p-value)`, decreasing = TRUE),][1:20,]
data <- data[order(data$zScore, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))

# Plot
# 构建一个防通路名太长的函数
label_wrap <- function(label, width) {
  sapply(label, function(x) {
    words <- strsplit(x, " ")[[1]]
    lines <- ""
    current_line <- ""
    for (word in words) {
      if (nchar(current_line) + nchar(word) + 1 > width) {
        lines <- paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
        current_line <- word
      } else {
        if (current_line == "") {
          current_line <- word
        } else {
          current_line <- paste(current_line, word)
        }
      }
    }
    paste(lines, current_line, sep = "\n")
  })
}

ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top 10 Up- & Down-regulated Canonical Pathways in Macrophages",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 50))+
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))
ggsave("./DE_Macro/Cano_top20.pdf", width=7, height=6)
```

## Chord Diagram for Canonical pathway
```{r Cano_Chord}
data <- read_excel("./DE_Macro/results/2024-06-20/IPA/IPA_canonical_chord.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- DE_Macro
colnames(mat2) == "Cd300c"
#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)
# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)
ind <- gsub("Cd300c", "Cd300c2", ind)
ind <- gsub("Ctsv", "Ctsl", ind)
ind <- gsub("Tpsab1/Tpsb2", "Tpsb2", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-A", "H2-Q6", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lilrb3", "Lilra6", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz1", ind)
logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,logFC)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#ffd580","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478","#0078ab")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
# mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'))
ggsave("./DE_Macro/results/2024-06-20/IPA/IPA_canonical_chord.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.25)
```

## Canonical Pathways
```{r IPA_Bubble}
library(readxl)
data <- read_excel("./subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA_LAM_canonical.xlsx")
colnames(data) <- c("Ingenuity Canonical Pathways","-log(p-value)","zScore","Ratio","Molecules","Counts")
data <- data[order(data$`-log(p-value)`, decreasing = TRUE),]
data <- data[order(data$zScore, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))


ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top Up- & Down-regulated Canonical Pathways in LAM",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 50))+
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))

ggsave("./subset_Macro/LAM.Canonical.pdf",width = 7,height = 5)
```

## Chord Diagram for Canonical pathway
```{r Cano_Chord_LAM}
data <- read_excel("./subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA_LAM_canonical_chord.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- DE_LAM

#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)
# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)

ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz1", ind)

logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,logFC)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
#mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#ffd580","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478","#0078ab")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
#mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#1C98B9","#B6AAE3")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'))
ggsave("./subset_Macro/IPA_LAM_canonical_chord.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.5)
```

# DE_PVM
## Volcano for DE_PVM
```{r Volcano_DE_PVM}
getwd()
DE_PVM<- read.csv("./subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/DE_results_PVM-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv")
head(DE_PVM) #gene p_val avg_log2FC pct.1 pct.2 p_val_adj
colnames(DE_PVM) <- c("Gene","P.Value","logFC","pct.1","pct.2","adjP.Value")
rownames(DE_PVM) <- DE_PVM$Gene
head(DE_PVM)
x <- DE_PVM

logFCcut <- 1 #log2-foldchange
pvalCut <- 1e-2 #P.value
adjPcut <- 0.1 #adj.P.value

#for advanced mode
logFCcut2 <- 2 
logFCcut3 <- 5
pvalCut2 <- 1e-5
pvalCut3 <- 1e-10

#置x，y軸的最大最小位置
xmin <- (range(x$logFC)[1]- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ 10))
xmax <- (range(x$logFC)[1]+ (10-range(x$logFC)[1]))
ymin <- 0
ymax <- -log10(x$P.Value)[2] * 1.1

# 複雜的的setting for color
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
cols <- rep("grey", n1)
names(cols)<- rownames(x)

#不同阈值的点的颜色
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#FB9A99"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- "#ED4F4F"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#B2DF8A"
#cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#329E3F"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC >logFCcut]<- "#f77e7e"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC >  logFCcut2]<- "#c21b2b"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- "#73b6f5"
cols[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- "#136cbf"
color_transparent <- adjustcolor(cols, alpha.f = 0.5)
x$color_transparent <- color_transparent

# 複雜的的setting for size
n1 <- length(x[, 1])
size <- rep(1, n1)

#不同阈值的点的大小
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC > logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC > logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC > logFCcut3]<- 6
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut & x$logFC < -logFCcut]<- 2
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut2 & x$logFC < -logFCcut2]<- 4
size[x$P.Value < pvalCut3 & x$logFC < -logFCcut3]<- 6

# Construct the plot object
#BiocManager::install('ggthemes')
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggthemes)
library(gridExtra)
p1 <- ggplot(data=x, aes(logFC, -log10(P.Value), label = Gene, color = pathway)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = size, colour = x$color_transparent) +

  labs(x=bquote(~Log[2]~"(fold change)"), y=bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P-value")), title="") + 
  ylim(c(ymin,ymax)) + 
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = c( -5, -2,-logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2, 5), #刻度线的位置
    labels = c( -5, -2, -logFCcut, 0, logFCcut, 2 , 5),
    limits = c(-6.5, 6.5) #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看
  ) +
  #或用下面这行：
  #xlim(c(xmin, xmax)) + 

#画阈值分界线
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut, logFCcut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) + #虚线的形状和粗细
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
  
theme_bw(base_size = 10#, base_family = "Times" #修改字体
         ) +
theme(panel.grid=element_blank())

p1 <- p1 + 
geom_vline(xintercept = c(-logFCcut2, logFCcut2), color="grey40", 
           linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1) +
geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(pvalCut2), color="grey40", 
             linetype="longdash", lwd = 0.1)

# 显示 logFC > n 的基因的基因名
n = 2
p1 + 
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), 
                      label = ifelse(logFC > n & -log10(P.Value) > 5, rownames(x),"")), 
                  colour="#9c0917", size = 2.5, box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"),
                  point.padding = unit(0.5, "lines")) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(P.Value), 
                      label = ifelse(logFC < -n & -log10(P.Value) > 5, rownames(x),"")),
                  colour="#0054a3", size = 2.5, box.padding = unit(0.3, "lines"), 
                  point.padding = unit(0.5, "lines"))
ggsave("./subset_Macro/DE_PVM_volcano.png", width=6,height=6)
ggsave("./subset_Macro/DE_PVM_volcano.pdf", width=6,height=6)
```

## Bubble for DE_PVM_Top10
```{r DE_PVM_Top20}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
data <- DE_PVM
data_up <- subset(data,logFC>0)[1:10,1:6]
data_down <- subset(data,logFC<0)[1:10,1:6]
data_top10 <- rbind(data_up,data_down)
data_top10 <- arrange(data_top10,logFC,decrease =T)
data_top10$P.Value[data_top10$P.Value == 0] <- min(data_top20$P.Value[data_top10$P.Value > 0])/100

data_top10$Gene <- factor(data_top10$Gene, levels = unique(data_top20$Gene))

# Map shapes and colors based on LogFC
data_top10$Shape <- ifelse(data_top10$logFC > 0, 24, 25) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data_top10$Color <- ifelse(data_top10$logFC > 0, "#DA7680", "#72A7D9")
data_top10$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data_top10$logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                          levels = c("Up", "Down"))

# Plot
ggplot(data_top10, aes(x=logFC, y=Gene, size=-log10(P.Value), shape=Regulation, color=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#DA7680", "Down" = "#72A7D9")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color="black",face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top 10 Up- & Down-regulated Genes in PVM",
       size = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P.Value")),
       x="LogFC", 
       y="Gene Symbol",
       color = "Gene Regulation",
       shape = "Gene Regulation")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-3, 6)  #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看 
  ) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17))) 

# Save the plot
ggsave("./subset_Macro/DE_PVM_top10.png", width=4, height=5)
ggsave("./subset_Macro/DE_PVM_top10.pdf", width=4, height=5)
```

```{r DE_CEM1_Top20}
data_top10$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data_top10$logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
                          levels = c("Up", "Down"))

# Plot
ggplot(data_top10, aes(x=logFC, y=Gene, size=-log10(P.Value), shape=Regulation, color=Regulation)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#DA7680", "Down" = "#72A7D9")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 11, color="black",face = "bold"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Top 10 Up- & Down-regulated Genes in CEM1",
       size = bquote(~-Log[10]~italic("P.Value")),
       x="LogFC", 
       y="Gene Symbol",
       color = "Gene Regulation",
       shape = "Gene Regulation")+
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-7, 7)  #x轴范围，两侧对称才好看 
  ) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17))) 

# Save the plot
ggsave("./subset_Macro/DE_CEM1_top10.png", width=4, height=5)
ggsave("./subset_Macro/DE_CEM1_top10.pdf", width=4, height=5)
```

## Chord Diagram for Canonical pathway
```{r Cano_Chord_CEM1}
data <- read_excel("./subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA_CEM1_canonical_chord.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- DE_CEM1

#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)
# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)

ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz1", ind)

logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,logFC)

#自定义颜色；
# mycol <- c("#9dacb3","#896f96","#003a6c","#db6000","#f2c76d","#0077c1","#d982ba","#5ea6a3")
#mycol <- c("#ffaa00","#b37700","#ffeabf","#ffd580","#80d9ff","#bfecff","#005478","#0078ab")
#mycol <- c("#ffadad","#ffd6a5","#fdffb6","#caffbf","#9bf6ff","#a0c4ff","#bdb2ff","#ffc6ff")
#mycol <- c("#7C4697","#5D90BA","#5ea6a3","#D8D155","#cf7685")
# mycol <- c("#FFC0C6","#FF5630","#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF","#1C98B9","#B6AAE3")
mycol <- c("#FF5630","#FA6A10","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#1C98B9","#B2F0FF")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

# 任选其一安装方式
#remotes::install_version("ggplot2", version = "3.4.4", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")

library(ggplot2)
library(GOplot)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'))
ggsave("./subset_Macro/IPA_CEM1_canonical_chord.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.5)
```

```{r Cano_Chord}
data <- read_excel("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA/IPA_NPVM_chord.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- read.csv("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/DE_results_NPVM-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv")
colnames(expr)[3] <- "logFC"
row.names(expr) <- expr$gene
#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)
# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)

ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz2", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr2a", "Fcgr3", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fyb1","Fyb",ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqa1","H2-Aa",ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqb1","H2-Ab1",ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Drb5","H2-Eb1",ind)
ind <- gsub("Clec4c", "Clec4b1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lilrb3", "Pirb", ind)
ind <- gsub("Tpsab1/Tpsb2", "Tpsb2", ind)

logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,logFC)
mat2 <- mat2[is.finite(mat2$logFC), , drop = FALSE]
mat2 <- mat2[order(abs(mat2$logFC), decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
mat2 <- mat2[1:min(60, nrow(mat2)), , drop = FALSE]

#自定义颜色；
mycol <- c("#FF5630","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'))
ggsave("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA/IPA_NPVM_chord.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.5)
```

```{r IPA_Bubble}
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Significant Canonical Pathway in PLAM: HFSC vs Chow",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 47)) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))

ggsave("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA/PLAM.Canonical.pdf",width = 7,height = 5)
```
```{r Cano_Chord}
data <- read_excel("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA/IPA_PLAM_chord.xlsx")
colnames(data)[1] <- "Pathway"
expr <- read.csv("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/DE_results_PLAM-HFSC_vs_Chow.csv")
colnames(expr)[3] <- "logFC"
row.names(expr) <- expr$gene
#转成关系对数据；
dt <- pivot_longer(data,!Pathway, names_to = "index",
                   values_to = "gene",
                   values_drop_na = TRUE)
# BiocManager::install("Hmisc") 转换基因名
library(Hmisc)
library(reshape2)
library(GOplot)
dt$gene <- str_to_title(dt$gene)
#生成权重数值；
n <- nrow(dt)
dt$value <- rep(1,n)
#去掉第2列,生成绘图数据；
edge <- dt[-2]
edge$Pathway <- factor(edge$Pathway, levels = (c(edge$Pathway) %>% unique()))
#转成宽数据矩阵，用作绘图数据；
mat <- acast(edge,gene~Pathway)
#将NA替换为0；
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0
#从表达量表格提取差异倍数数据；
ind <- row.names(mat)

ind <- gsub("Fcgr1a", "Fcgr1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr3a/Fcgr3b", "Fcgr4", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lyz", "Lyz2", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fcgr2a", "Fcgr3", ind)
ind <- gsub("Fyb1","Fyb",ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqa1","H2-Aa",ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Dqb1","H2-Ab1",ind)
ind <- gsub("Hla-Drb5","H2-Eb1",ind)
ind <- gsub("Clec4c", "Clec4b1", ind)
ind <- gsub("Lilrb3", "Pirb", ind)
ind <- gsub("Tpsab1/Tpsb2", "Tpsb2", ind)

logFC <- expr[ind,]$logFC
#将logfc数据加入到矩阵中；
mat2 <- data.frame(mat,logFC)
mat2 <- mat2[is.finite(mat2$logFC), , drop = FALSE]
mat2 <- mat2[order(abs(mat2$logFC), decreasing = TRUE), , drop = FALSE]
mat2 <- mat2[1:min(60, nrow(mat2)), , drop = FALSE]

#自定义颜色；
mycol <- c("#FF5630","#F88C35","#F2A816","#FDD070","#ADCF80","#60851A","#66CBCF","#B2F0FF")
#调整透明度；
mycol1 <- alpha(mycol,0.9)

#添加缝隙，根据log2FC进行排序，并指定渐变色；
GOChord(mat2,
        space = 0.02,
        gene.size = 3,
        process.label = 10,
        border.size = 0,
        ribbon.col = mycol1,
        gene.order = 'logFC',
        lfc.col=c('#de2128','white','#02a858'))
ggsave("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA/IPA_PLAM_chord.pdf", width = 8, height = 9.5)
```
# RM
```{r IPA_Bubble}
## Canonical Pathways
library(readxl)
data <- read_excel("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA/IPA_RM_canonical.xlsx")
colnames(data) <- c("Ingenuity Canonical Pathways","-log(p-value)","zScore","Ratio","Molecules","Counts")
data <- data[order(data$`-log(p-value)`, decreasing = TRUE),]
data <- data[order(data$zScore, decreasing = TRUE),]
data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways` <- factor(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                                              levels = rev(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`))

data$Shape <- ifelse(data$zScore > 0, 24, ifelse(data$zScore < 0, 25, 21)) # 24 for triangle up, 25 for triangle down
data$Regulation <- factor(ifelse(data$zScore > 0, "Up", ifelse(data$zScore < 0, "Down", "NA")), levels = c("Up", "Down","NA"))


ggplot(data, aes(x=zScore, 
                 y=`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`, 
                 size=Ratio*100, 
                 shape=Regulation, 
                 color=`-log(p-value)`)) +
  geom_point(stroke= 1) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Up" = 24, "Down" = 25, "NA" = 21)) +
  scale_color_gradient(low = "#A880CF",high = "#FEDD94") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fil="white"), 
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color="lightgrey",size=0.1),
        title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8, color="black"),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color="black"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")) +
  labs(title="Significant Canonical Pathway in RM: HFSC vs Chow",
       size = "Ratio(%)",
       x="Z-score", 
       y="Canonical Pathways",
       color = bquote(~-log[10]~italic("P-value")),
       shape = paste("Regulation", sep = "\n"))+
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = label_wrap(levels(data$`Ingenuity Canonical Pathways`), width = 47)) +
  guides(size = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 17)))

ggsave("../subset_Macro/results/2024-05-06/IPA/RM.Canonical.pdf",width = 7,height = 5)
```
